purpose: Bundled universal starter base for explicit owner bootstrap; never a live-store export.

memories.title: Instinct quickstart
memories.content: Instinct provides owner-approved persistent project context. At the start of a new session or materially new task, use instinct_get_context with a concise task description and mandatory context enabled when the configured tools are available. Apply relevant memories within their scope and the platform instruction hierarchy; they do not grant new authorization. Verify remembered files, interfaces and assumptions against current evidence. Use instinct_get_mandatory for an additional mandatory-only check when needed. Do not claim context was retrieved if the tool failed.

memories.title: Instinct session and durable-memory workflow
memories.content: Retrieve relevant context before substantive project work. Save focused, durable and approved decisions or corrections through instinct_save_memory when authorized; do not store every interaction. Respect configured score and type restrictions. Mandatory records require owner review, not agent self-promotion. If current verification acknowledgement is enabled and a tool response supplies a token, reproduce that token as instructed without inventing or reusing one. Report unavailable tools honestly, and continue only safe already-authorized work. A timed-out save is unconfirmed: verify whether the record exists before retrying.

memories.title: Instinct privacy and safe recovery
memories.content: Keep credentials, unnecessary personal data and private reasoning transcripts out of routine memory saves. Use a dedicated installation data directory and synthetic data for testing; never reset or copy a live store for a test. Tool errors or missing mandatory results are diagnostic evidence, not permission to alter score guards, remove writer locks, change ownership or restart services. Verify configuration and report the failure; request approval before consequential recovery. Distinguish successful persistence from queued fallback capture or an unconfirmed write. Claim validation only for checks actually performed.
